name: currency-codes
title: ISO 4217 Currency Codes
description: ISO 4217 currency codes: current currencies (Table A.1) and historic denominations (Table A.3), sourced from SIX Interbank Clearing Ltd on behalf of ISO.

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0

sources.name: SIX Interbank Clearing Ltd (on behalf of ISO)
sources.title: SIX Interbank Clearing Ltd (on behalf of ISO)

resources.name: codes-all
resources.description: Consolidated list of ISO 4217 current and historic currency codes, one row per country–currency pair.

fields.name: Entity
fields.description: Country or other entity that uses the currency; also includes 13 'ZZ..' rows for funds and metals and a few international bodies

fields.name: AlphabeticCode
fields.title: Alphabetic Code
fields.description: 3-letter alphabetic code for the currency; empty on 3 'No universal currency' rows

fields.name: NumericCode
fields.title: Numeric Code
fields.description: 3-digit numeric code, zero-padded, e.g. '008'; empty on 6 rows

fields.name: MinorUnit
fields.title: Minor Unit
fields.description: Number of digits after the decimal separator; '-' where the source says N.A. (13 rows); empty on withdrawn rows

fields.name: WithdrawalDate
fields.title: Withdrawal Date
fields.description: Date the currency was withdrawn: YYYY-MM or a range (e.g. '1990-07 to 1990-09'); empty for current currencies
